chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 254 – Baolu’s Fix: Li Huowang’s Final Gift Before Leaving Qingqiu
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang corrects Sun Baolu’s Danyangzi-inflicted body horror before leaving Qingqiu, but Gao Zhijian’s ominous warning lingers under the feast.
og_title: Li Huowang Restores a Friend’s Body in Chapter 254
og_description: A rare moment of healing in the Dao-Twisted World: Li Huowang fixes Sun Baolu’s misplaced organs. But not everyone trusts the celebration.
twitter_title: Li Huowang fixes Sun Baolu’s body before leaving Qingqiu
twitter_description: A moment of surgical kindness — but Gao Zhijian knows something is wrong with this place.

lore_anchors.definition: In Chinese folk Daoist practice, a white tassel or brush could be used in ritual adjustments, here repurposed for a literal, gruesome organ correction.
A local geographic name in the Dao-Twisted World; the hills are said to resemble a reclining woman’s silhouette when viewed from a certain angle, serving as a livestock source.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Gao Zhijian think Qingqiu is wrong?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He can’t articulate it, but his unformed intuition is a classic horror signal — the feast feels too happy, and the town’s corruption (the Lion-Masks) is politely ignored by everyone, hinting at a systemic rot beneath the hospitality.

No. Li Huowang’s correction is practical, not perfect — Baolu’s organs are “a bit crooked” — but the restoration of their proper anatomical positions is enough to make him feel human again and break the monster identity Danyangzi forced on him.
